A suspect in an alleged sucker‑punching incident has been arrested and charged with assault. During questioning the accused told police he was “having a bad day,” which he cited as a motive for the attack, but authorities have not accepted this explanation as a defense. The case remains under investigation while prosecutors assess evidence to determine potential penalties.
